description: Fintech reports, white papers, surveys and data, newest first, with publisher, type, date and gated flag. Reports are published by the companies, investors, consultancies and analysts named as publisher; we link to the publisher's page and never host the file. Figures are quoted exactly as written, each with page_ref (a page number, or 'web' for an HTML page). gated = registration required at the publisher. Arguments: q (or query, ≥2 characters) matched against title and summary; topic (topic slug); publisher (organisation or person slug); report_type; year; gated (true/false); limit (≤50); cursor (next_cursor from a previous call). Use get_report for figures and coverage. Unknown arguments are rejected.

gated.description: true = registration required at the publisher; false = free to read.

q.description: Text matched against report title and summary (at least 2 characters).

report_type.description: survey, market_data, index, white_paper, regulatory_analysis or industry_research.

name: search_reports
title: Search fintech reports
